rationale: The agent properly verified the user by matching full name and ZIP via the tool, then retrieved the user’s orders and identified the delivered order containing the office chair. The agent requested explicit confirmation before performing any order-changing action. When the user paused, the agent did nothing; when the user switched to an exchange, the agent re-stated the exact change and sought confirmation. After receiving “yes,” the agent executed the correct exchange tool call on the correct item and order, using the correct payment method, and the tool confirmed status “exchange requested.” The agent’s final message accurately reflected the tool results. No fabricated details, no unauthorized actions, and compliance with the policy throughout.
